content.content:
Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household id
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true, joining an existing owner that has the same
                last name and address. Owners of the same household share this value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively (excluding this owner). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation time. Starts
                at 1, adds 1 when an email is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                and is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                current business day at the time of this response; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'PHONE'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                Two owners collide (create rejected with 409) only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no 'birthDate' was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four
            digits and valid for the city's region per the fixed table (NSW
            2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-14'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only create-time flag. When true, the owner is allowed to share a
            household (same last name and address) with an existing owner; otherwise a
            create request colliding with an existing household is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household id
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true, joining an existing owner that has the same
                last name and address. Owners of the same household share this value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively (excluding this owner). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation time. Starts
                at 1, adds 1 when an email is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                and is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                current business day at the time of this response; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'PHONE'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                Two owners collide (create rejected with 409) only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no 'birthDate' was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
